feedback.text: The variable terms cancel; do not solve by combining constants as x.

When variables cancel, check the remaining statement. This choice reflects a common error or incomplete step. Recheck the mapped lesson method, compare the representation or equation carefully, and identify where the reasoning changes.

The remaining statement is false, not true. This choice reflects a common error or incomplete step. Recheck the mapped lesson method, compare the representation or equation carefully, and identify where the reasoning changes.
